review_notes: The file has one theorem, a naturality square relating colimMap (whiskerLeft F α) and colimit.post. It is stated as an equation between two composites with no simplification-normal-form orientation. I searched the formal-frontier sources and the Mathlib Limits directory. The only use is an explicit `exact colimMap_whiskerLeft_comp_colimit_post F _ _ _` in HigherDirectImageFilteredColimitPositive.lean. Mathlib has no existing simp rule that this lemma would compete with or duplicate. Adding `@[simp]` would not clearly improve the normal form, because both sides are composites that are equally canonical. The use site does not rely on simp. I did not find a concrete simp-interface defect, such as a missing canonical lemma, a bad orientation, competing rules or a rewrite cycle. A `reassoc` variant would be a different concern, not a simp one. I did not run Lean.
